title: Worse than the Android version on every level
body: The Android version of this app opens immediately to the page where you can track contractions. This version takes you through at least seven different unskippable pages asking optional information before giving you access to what you need — a button to tap that records the time for you. It’s embarrassing that their latest app update includes “removing full screen ads so you’re not distracted between contractions” — either maintain an app that provides a straightforward service or don’t, but stop with the dark patterns that show you clearly don’t care about your primary user base. I would like to see more contraction timer options that are a step up from using the default Stopwatch app on your phone (which has its own limitations or I wouldn’t be looking for a separate app), without sacrificing so much sanity to dealing with data collection during what the app creators know is a stressful time.

title: Needs more free features
